text: The bus didn't come again. Third time this week. Stood in the rain for forty minutes and was late for the shift, again.
The bus driver saw me running and pulled away anyway, laughing with the man at the front. Forty minutes in the rain. I'm furious.
Spent the whole evening trying to get the router to work. Unplugged it, reset it, rang the helpline twice. Still nothing.
The broadband company has charged me for three months of a service they cut off, and the manager just told me 'tough'. I'm so angry I'm shaking.
Tried to finish the report but kept getting pulled into calls. Got two paragraphs done all day. Going nowhere.
Found out Callum put his name on my report and sent it to the director before I'd even seen the final version. I'm raging.
Lost the remote again, the kids have hidden my charger and I can't find a single matching sock. Small stuff, all day.
Someone at school told Mia she was 'too dark' to play the princess. A grown adult said that to my seven-year-old. I'm livid.
Bread failed for the third time. Came out flat as a plate. No idea what I'm doing wrong.
My brother-in-law laughed at my bread in front of everyone and called it 'cute', then did it again when I asked him to stop. I wanted to throw it at him.
The form keeps rejecting my postcode. Rang them and they said it's 'a known issue'. Can't renew the licence until it's fixed.
The clerk refused to renew my licence because of my accent, said he 'couldn't understand' me, and waved the next person forward. I'm fuming.
Ran the same test twenty times. Fails on the server, passes on my laptop. Three days on this one bug.
Daniel deleted my branch to 'tidy up' and then told the standup I hadn't done the work. Three days of work. I'm absolutely seething.
Mum keeps forgetting to charge her phone so I can never get hold of her. Fourth time this week I've rung and rung.
The care home left Mum in the same clothes for three days and nobody told us. When I asked, the manager shrugged. I'm so angry I can't sit still.
Stuck in the same jam on the ring road for an hour. Missed the start of the film. What a waste of an evening.
A man in a van tailgated us for five miles with the kids in the back, then swerved in front and braked hard. I'm still furious hours later.
Dropped from the team for Saturday again, no reason given. Training hard and getting nowhere.
Dropped from the team for Saturday so the coach could play his nephew, who's missed half the sessions. Everyone knows why. I'm so angry.
Cleared out Grandad's shed today. His tools still had his initials scratched on them. I couldn't stop crying.
Cleared out Grandad's shed today. Thinking about how he fixed everything and threw nothing away. I wonder what I'll leave behind.
Saw our old house on a property website. Someone's painted over the kitchen. Felt like losing it all over again.
Saw our old house on a property website. Funny how small it looks. I've been thinking about who I was when we lived there.
Isla and I aren't really friends any more. No row, we just drifted. I miss her more than I can say.
Isla and I aren't really friends any more. No row, we just drifted. I've been wondering whether some friendships are just for a season.
Last day at the school where I've taught for twenty years. Packed my desk into two boxes and drove home in silence.
Last day at the school where I've taught for twenty years. Thinking about the kids who'll be grown now and what I'd tell my first-year self.
The vet says Bonnie hasn't got long. Sat with her in the garden all afternoon. Everything feels heavy.
Bonnie's getting old. Sat with her in the garden and thought about all the walks, and how a dog quietly organises your whole life.
Didn't get the part. Sat in the car outside the theatre for an hour. I really thought this was the one.
Didn't get the part, second time this year. Wondering if I want acting for itself or for what it would prove.
Mum's birthday today, the first without her. Bought the cake out of habit and couldn't eat it.
Mum would have been seventy today. Looked through her recipe book and noticed how much of how I cook is really hers.
Moved out of the flat Joe and I shared. Handed back the keys and cried all the way down the stairs.
Moved out of the flat Joe and I shared. Five years. Turning over what we were good at and what we never managed to say.
My son doesn't need me to walk him to school any more. He told me at the gate. I went home and sat on his bed.
My son doesn't need me to walk him to school any more. Thinking about how parenting is mostly practising being left.
Found my old running medals in a box. Haven't been able to run since the accident. Put them back and closed the lid.
Found my old running medals in a box. Strange how much that girl needed to win. I'd like to know what she'd make of me now.
Two night shifts back to back. Slept till three, ate cereal, back to bed. Nothing left in the tank.
Two night shifts, parents' evening, the car in for its MOT and a deadline on Friday. Every time I clear one thing, three more land.
Long drive back from Leeds. My eyes kept closing at the lights. Going straight to bed.
Back from Leeds to forty emails, a leaking roof, Dad's hospital letter and a party I'm hosting tomorrow. I don't know where to begin.
Baby was up four times. I'm walking around in a fog and put the milk in the cupboard again.
Baby up four times, the twins both sick, the washing machine broken and work asking when I'll be back. I'm drowning in it.
Moved house today. Every muscle aches. Lying on a mattress on the floor, too worn out to find the kettle.
Moved house today. Boxes everywhere, no internet, the old keys still to return, school forms due and the new job starts Monday. Too much.
Exam season. Invigilated three papers today. Legs like lead. Asleep by nine.
Exam season: three papers to invigilate, ninety scripts to mark, reports due and the head wants the new timetable by Thursday. I can't hold it all.
Ran the half marathon this morning. Completely spent. Napped on the sofa for three hours.
Ran the half this morning and came back to the in-laws arriving early, the dog missing and a burst pipe in the hall. Everything at once.
End of a twelve-hour day at the restaurant. Feet throbbing. Too tired to even shower.
Twelve-hour day at the restaurant, two staff off sick, an inspection due, the supplier late and the till broken. I couldn't keep up with any of it.
Grandma's ninetieth went on until midnight. Lovely, but I'm wiped out.
Organising Grandma's ninetieth: forty guests, three dietary lists, the venue changing the date and my aunt ringing every hour. My head is spinning.
Studied until two last night. Today I've read the same page five times. Brain's switched off.
Three essays due this week, a shift every night, my flatmate moving out and the rent going up. I keep opening my laptop and closing it again.
Back from the hospital after sitting with Dad all day. Worn out, just want to sleep.
Dad's in hospital, I'm the only one who can drive him, work wants me in, the kids need picking up and the consultant won't call back. It's all landing on me at once.
Waited in for the delivery all day. It didn't come. No email, no call. Wasted my day off.
The parcel with Nan's medication didn't come and the tracking just says 'delayed'. She runs out on Thursday. I keep checking the page.
The visa office lost my form again. Third time sending it. They keep asking for things I've already given them.
The visa office lost my form again and my permit runs out in three weeks. If it doesn't come through I don't know what happens to the job or the flat.
Laptop crashed mid-presentation. Had to start the slides again while everyone watched. So annoying.
Presenting to the board tomorrow and I keep picturing the laptop crashing and my mind going blank. Can't settle.
Builder's late again. Said Monday, then Wednesday, now 'next week'. The kitchen's been in bits for a month.
The builder found damp behind the wall and said 'we'll see how bad it is'. I've been lying awake wondering what it'll cost and whether we can cover it.
Kai's school changed the pick-up time again without telling anyone. Stood at the gate for forty minutes.
Kai wasn't at the gate at pick-up and the office didn't know where he was. Ten minutes until they found him in the library. My heart is still going.
My manager moved our one-to-one for the fifth time. I just want twenty minutes to talk about the promotion.
My manager booked a 'quick chat' for Friday with HR on the invite and no agenda. I've thought about nothing else all evening.
The bank's app has been down all morning. Can't move money, can't pay the window cleaner, can't do anything.
The bank flagged 'unusual activity' and froze the account. Rent goes out tomorrow. On hold for an hour and I can't stop imagining the worst.
Jo cancelled on me again, an hour before. Third time this month. I'd already booked the table.
Jo hasn't replied in four days, which isn't like her at all, and her last message was a bit strange. I keep checking my phone.
The scan got moved again. Took the morning off for nothing. Now it's another two weeks.
The scan got moved again, so it's two more weeks of not knowing what the lump is. I can't concentrate on anything.
Flight delayed four hours. Sat on the airport floor eating overpriced crisps. Nobody tells you anything.
Flight's delayed and the connection to Lagos leaves ninety minutes after we land. If we miss it I miss Dad's operation. Watching the board every few seconds.
